agent_note: Third-person past narration throughout; 27 event quotes, 27 past / 0 present. Quotation marks survive on only some quotes (Goodreads strips the opening mark on many and all marks on others), so where marks were absent dialogue was identified by 1st/2nd-person direct address, vocatives, imperatives and speech register inside an otherwise 3rd-person past narrative -- recorded per quote. Only one true gnomic (q09931). Several past-framed generalisations (q09906, q09941, q09956, q09973) kept as event/past per the present-only gnomic rule. Three abstentions: q09917 (present-tense, unmarked, speech-vs-interior-monologue -- the only quote that could add present evidence) and q09925/q09939 (wholly counterfactual).
